name: Stacy
tagline: A safety voice agent that keeps you calm, logs the incident, shares your location and escalates to police.
problem: People in uncomfortable situations that may escalate have nobody on the line.
solution: A voice agent with live location, incident case building, contact notification, warm handoff to police and navigation to safe places.
demo_moment: Team-described: start a call and hear Stacy guide you to the nearest police station.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VAPI: Best Voice AI Application” among 261 submissions.
A duo new to AI agents shipped it.

lessons: A voice agent with a clear job in a stressful moment is easy to judge.
